source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

carry.quote: Your cleanup. Once a hero drops low, missiles chase them through walls, so Piercing Shot can finish runners. Wind-Rider adds attack speed as Heightened Senses ends your Stealth.
carry.issue: invented causal link: Weald missiles don't make Piercing Shot finish runners
carry.rewrite: Your cleanup. Once a hero drops low, missiles chase them through walls to finish runners. Wind-Rider adds attack speed as Heightened Senses ends your Stealth.

midlane.quote: Every Brine, Narcosis and Genesis hit leaves a burn that keeps ticking, so poke with bubble pops and let it finish them. Lich heals you off that ability damage.
midlane.issue: overstates a small DoT as a finisher; "burn" not in source
midlane.rewrite: Every Brine, Narcosis and Genesis hit adds extra damage over time, so keep poking with bubble pops. Lich heals you off that ability damage.

offlane.quote: Rewards staying on one hero. Stun them with Shield Bash or Shield Slam, then land three Punches in a row; Crush adds damage whenever your stuns land.
offlane.issue: Crush has a per-target cooldown, not every stun
offlane.rewrite: Rewards staying on one hero. Stun them with Shield Bash or Shield Slam, then land three Punches in a row; Crush adds damage when a stun lands, on a cooldown.

midlane.quote: Lane poke pays: each Soulfire or Stupor hit on a hero earns gold and restores mana over time. Runic Focus adds power while your mana bar stays high.
midlane.issue: mana regen comes from every cast, not from hits
midlane.rewrite: Lane poke pays: Soulfire or Stupor hits on heroes earn gold, and every cast builds mana regen. Runic Focus adds power while your mana bar stays high.

jungle.quote: Your finisher: once a target falls under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so don't chase into fog. Wind-Rider's attack speed after Heaven's Fury teleports you adds extra missiles.
jungle.rewrite: Once a target falls under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so don't chase them out of sight. Wind-Rider's attack speed after Heaven's Fury teleports you adds extra missiles.

jungle.quote: Rushing Beat, Line Tempo and All-Kill! hits leave a lingering burn, so burst a target and let it finish them as they flee. Lich heals you off that damage.
jungle.issue: overstates a small DoT as able to finish fleeing targets
jungle.rewrite: Rushing Beat, Line Tempo and All-Kill! hits add a bit of extra damage over time after your burst. Lich heals you off that damage.

midlane.quote: Boosts the stats on every item you buy, rewarding a smooth item build over risky fights. Memory Leak grows your mana pool as you cast L.I.N.X and Data Burst.
midlane.issue: 'over risky fights' is unsupported, vague advice
midlane.rewrite: Boosts the stats on every item you buy, so it grows stronger as your build fills out. Memory Leak grows your mana pool as you cast L.I.N.X and Data Burst.

midlane.quote: Each L.I.N.X or Data Burst that hits a hero earns gold and mana back, so poke often in lane. Runic Focus adds power while you keep mana high.
midlane.issue: mana regen comes from every cast, not from hits
midlane.rewrite: Every cast builds mana regen, and each L.I.N.X or Data Burst that hits a hero earns gold, so poke often in lane. Runic Focus adds power while mana stays high.

carry.quote: Your items give more stats, so finish each item before buying the next. Tri-Core adds a random bonus to every Fate shot, which suits Revenant's basic-attack damage.
carry.issue: Tri-Core adds bonus damage of a random type, not a random bonus
carry.rewrite: Your items give more stats, so finish each item before buying the next. Tri-Core adds extra damage of a random type to every Fate shot, which suits Revenant's basic attacks.

support.quote: Harvest Nettles and Untamed Growth hits on heroes earn gold and stack mana regen, which Arcane Resonance turns into faster cooldowns. Philosopher adds steady gold while you roam.
support.issue: mana regen comes from every cast, not from hits
support.rewrite: Every cast stacks mana regen, which Arcane Resonance turns into faster cooldowns, and Harvest Nettles or Untamed Growth hits on heroes earn gold. Philosopher adds steady gold while you roam.

jungle.quote: A finisher: once a hero drops low, missiles chase them through walls, so you can stop chasing into fog. Dryad's Boon lets each club swing bring Double Pain back sooner.
jungle.issue: overconfident: small true-damage missiles don't guarantee the kill, so 'stop chasing' misleads
jungle.rewrite: Once a hero drops low, missiles chase them through walls for a little extra damage to help finish runners. Dryad's Boon lets each club swing bring Double Pain back sooner.

jungle.quote: Mark whoever you're hitting and stay on them. It pairs with Imperial Duelist, which also boosts your damage and cuts damage taken from your basic-attack target.
jungle.issue: cites Imperial Duelist, which is not Boris's augment (Apex Hunter) or in the source
jungle.rewrite: Mark whoever you're basic attacking and stay on them: you deal more damage to them and take less from them. Savage Strikes heals you as you keep hitting.

offlane.quote: Extra health and size let you stay in fights while Iron Rose and Thorns keep chipping. Brawl up front longer; Cannibalism grows your health with every takedown.
offlane.issue: Thorns deals no damage itself; it boosts allies' damage
offlane.rewrite: Extra health and size let you stay in fights while Iron Rose's vine keeps chipping. Brawl up front longer; Cannibalism grows your health with every takedown.

carry.quote: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so don't chase into fog. Taproot heals you with each Lucy shot, and Forage speeds up your farm.
carry.issue: "fog" jargon; Forage adds gold and XP rather than speed
carry.rewrite: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so don't chase out of sight. Taproot heals you each Lucy shot, and Forage adds gold and XP.

jungle.quote: Takedowns add random bonuses, and Reaping Dash already resets on takedowns, so dive on kills and chain them. Masterpiece stacks damage and speed with each kill.
jungle.issue: Reaping Dash cooldown is cut by 80% on takedown, not fully reset
jungle.rewrite: Takedowns add random bonuses and also cut most of Reaping Dash's cooldown, so dive on kills and chain them. Masterpiece stacks damage and speed with each kill.

offlane.quote: Every ability cast weakens nearby enemy heroes' damage, and Crunch casts constantly, so stay close and keep chaining abilities. Harmonic Currents refills health and mana with each cast.
offlane.issue: Harmonic Currents restores a small share of missing health and mana, not a refill
offlane.rewrite: Every cast weakens nearby enemy heroes' damage, and Crunch casts constantly, so stay close and keep chaining abilities. Harmonic Currents restores some missing health and mana.

support.quote: Ability hits on heroes earn gold and stack mana regen, and Arcane Resonance converts that regen into faster cooldowns. Philosopher keeps gold coming even on quiet stretches.
support.issue: mana regen comes from every cast, not from hits
support.rewrite: Every cast stacks mana regen, which Arcane Resonance converts into faster cooldowns, and ability hits on heroes earn gold. Philosopher keeps gold coming even on quiet stretches.

offlane.quote: Casting keeps mana regeneration flowing, and hero damage pays extra gold. Trade with Blade Siphon and Eventide often; Sacrifice refills mana whenever your abilities hit a hero.
offlane.issue: Sacrifice is a small missing-mana regen, not a refill
offlane.rewrite: Casting keeps mana regeneration flowing, and hero damage pays extra gold. Trade with Blade Siphon and Eventide often; Sacrifice tops up some mana whenever your abilities hit a hero.

jungle.quote: Your abilities leave an extra burn on top of Haemorrhage, so hit with Shadow Slip and Eventide and let both finish runners. Tithe of Death adds ability haste per takedown.
jungle.issue: overstates the extra DoT as finishing runners
jungle.rewrite: Your abilities add extra damage over time on top of Haemorrhage, so hit with Shadow Slip and Eventide before chasing. Tithe of Death adds ability haste per takedown.

offlane.quote: Marks whoever your Refibrillator shots hit, so pick one laner and keep shooting them. Ferocity keeps adding attack speed in long fights, piling on its stacking damage faster.
offlane.issue: "its stacking damage" wrongly reads as Ferocity's; means Refibrillator's DoT
offlane.rewrite: Marks whoever your Refibrillator shots hit, so pick one laner and keep shooting them. Ferocity adds attack speed in long fights, stacking Refibrillator's damage faster.

carry.quote: Turns your attacks into a finisher: hit a low-health hero and missiles chase them through walls, so don't follow into fog. Forage adds gold and XP from every farm kill.
carry.issue: overconfident: small true-damage missiles don't guarantee the kill, so 'don't follow' misleads
carry.rewrite: Hit a low-health hero and missiles chase them through walls, adding a little damage that can finish runners. Forage adds gold and XP from every farm kill.

jungle.quote: Extra health gives Stoicism more room to work as you take damage. Dive in and soak hits for your team; Cannibalism adds health with every takedown.
jungle.issue: vague 'more room to work' claim about Stoicism
jungle.rewrite: Extra health lets you dive in and soak hits for your team, and Stoicism's armor and regen grow as you lose health. Cannibalism adds health with every takedown.

carry.quote: Knock, Knock! and Peekaboo! keep burning after they land, adding chip to your long-range poke. Tithe of Death refills mana and lowers cooldowns with every takedown.
carry.issue: Tithe of Death restores part of your mana and adds capped haste, not a refill
carry.rewrite: Knock, Knock! and Peekaboo! keep burning after they land, adding chip to your long-range poke. Tithe of Death restores some mana and adds ability haste with each takedown.

offlane.quote: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so a long-range Long Arm of the Law can finish runners. Taproot heals you on each Enforcer shot.
offlane.issue: implies Weald lets the ult finish runners at any range; missiles vanish after a distance
offlane.rewrite: Once a hero drops under 30%, your next hit fires missiles that chase them through walls, so keep poking runners. Taproot heals you on each Enforcer shot.

support.quote: Rewards a support who keeps allies topped up: anyone you heal or shield attacks faster and hits harder for a few seconds. Omnipresent speeds up your roams out of combat.
support.issue: implies Narbash's kit triggers Exarch, but his songs only grant Health Regeneration; source never says regen counts as healing, and he has no shield
support.rewrite: Anyone you heal or shield attacks faster and hits harder briefly, but Narbash's songs grant health regeneration, not direct heals, so it may rarely trigger. Omnipresent speeds your roams.

support.quote: Your attacks and abilities strip enemy armor and give you part of it. Peal makes Reversal Of Fortune hit at full strength right away, so land and hit everyone.
support.issue: misdescribes Peal: it makes hits after your ultimate apply full Rust stacks, not make the ultimate hit harder
support.rewrite: Your attacks and abilities strip enemy armor and give you part of it. With Peal, hits right after Reversal Of Fortune apply full stacks, so land and hit everyone.

support.quote: Every Alacrity shield and Consecrated Ground heal arms allies with faster, harder-hitting attacks. Shield your carry as they start shooting; Revelation brings basic cooldowns back sooner.
support.issue: Consecrated Ground is a heal over time; source doesn't say it triggers Exarch
support.rewrite: Every Alacrity shield arms the ally it touches with faster, harder-hitting attacks. Shield your carry as they start shooting; Revelation brings basic cooldowns back sooner.

offlane.quote: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so don't follow them into fog. Taproot heals you with each basic attack, and Forage speeds up farming.
offlane.rewrite: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls, so don't chase out of sight. Taproot heals on each basic attack; Forage adds gold and XP.

offlane.quote: Heals you more the lower you get, so you can keep dueling while low. Roses pays extra gold on takedown streaks and boosts that healing right after a kill.
offlane.issue: Roses scales with total takedowns (no streak/reset in source) and the heal boost is on hero kills only
offlane.rewrite: Heals you more the lower you get, so you can keep dueling while low. Roses pays more gold as your takedowns add up and boosts that healing after hero kills.

offlane.quote: Mark, Hive and Swarm hits on heroes earn gold and stack mana regen, which Arcane Resonance turns into faster cooldowns. Keep steady pressure on your lane opponent.
offlane.issue: mana regen comes from every cast, not from hits
offlane.rewrite: Every cast stacks mana regen, which Arcane Resonance turns into faster cooldowns, and Mark, Hive and Swarm hits on heroes earn gold. Keep steady pressure on your lane opponent.

jungle.quote: Your finisher. Once a target drops low, missiles chase them through walls, so stop following runners into fog. Forage adds gold and XP; Taproot heals you every swing.
jungle.issue: overconfident: small true-damage missiles (hero-only) don't guarantee the kill, so 'stop following' misleads
jungle.rewrite: Once a hero drops low, missiles chase them through walls, adding a little damage that can finish runners. Forage adds gold and XP; Taproot heals you every swing.

support.quote: Essence Catalyst heals you and your linked ally after each cast, so every ability also gives both of you attack speed and magic damage. Link your carry and keep casting.
support.issue: claims Essence Catalyst heal-over-time triggers Exarch; source does not say so
support.rewrite: Each heal or shield you give boosts that ally's attack speed and adds magic damage to their basic attacks, so link your carry and keep them topped up.

support.quote: Casting builds mana and pays gold off hero damage, keeping item buys coming without farm. Perfection gives extra ability haste while you're healthy, so stay out of enemy poke.
support.issue: "without farm" overstates a small gold trickle
support.rewrite: Casting builds mana and pays some gold off hero damage, helping you afford items as support. Perfection gives extra ability haste while you're healthy, so stay out of enemy poke.

support.quote: Each cast stacks mana regeneration, and hero damage pays extra gold. Philosopher adds gold over time, and Arcane Resonance speeds basic cooldowns as regen builds.
support.issue: recites the descriptions without saying how to play
support.rewrite: Each cast stacks mana regeneration and hero damage pays extra gold, so poke with Maco Sparkle! and Maco Gift! often; Arcane Resonance then brings basic abilities back faster.

jungle.quote: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls. Pole Vault's leap triggers Wind-Rider, adding attack speed and more missiles, while Forage speeds up your clears.
jungle.issue: Forage gives extra gold and XP, not faster clears
jungle.rewrite: Once a hero drops under 30%, missiles chase them through walls. Pole Vault's leap triggers Wind-Rider for extra attack speed and missiles, and Forage adds gold and XP per kill.

jungle.quote: Stick to one target with basic attacks to keep the mark on them. Ferocity stacks attack speed through long fights, and Alpha's Court adds damage when you gank alone.
jungle.issue: Alpha's Court needs no ally nearby, which a gank usually has
jungle.rewrite: Stick to one target with basic attacks to keep the mark on them. Ferocity stacks attack speed in long fights; Alpha's Court adds damage when no ally is near.

midlane.quote: Rupture and Exsanguinate hits on heroes earn gold and stack mana regen, easing Exsanguinate's rising mana cost. Sacrifice refunds mana when abilities land; Runic Focus favors a full mana bar.
midlane.issue: mana regen comes from every cast, not from hits; Sacrifice is missing-mana regen on hero hits, not a refund
midlane.rewrite: Every cast stacks mana regen, easing Exsanguinate's rising mana cost, and ability hits on heroes earn gold. Sacrifice restores mana on hero hits; Runic Focus favors high mana.

jungle.quote: Random bonuses build over time and with each takedown. Severance resets keep you fighting to stack it, and Masterpiece's speed after kills reaches the next target.
jungle.issue: Severance resets don't stack Lotus; only time and takedowns do
jungle.rewrite: Random bonuses build over time and with each takedown. Chain Severance resets to secure kills, and Masterpiece's speed after kills reaches the next target.
